summary: Frontend regression + new-feature testing on Customizer (draggable+resizable engraved TEXT) and Products page (Hinglish marketing copy). All test items from the review request passed. Typing regression on order-print-text works and live preview updates. text-resize-slider changes computed font-size (verified: 51.2px -> 92.16px at scale 1.8, and -> 30.72px at scale 0.6). preview-text-block is draggable via pointer events (inline style left/top changed from 50%/32% to 75%/80% after mouse drag). Order flow ends-to-end works: POST /api/orders returned 200 with MC-CE41A4 order number, order-success visible, order-success-whatsapp opens wa.me link. Products page renders all 4 cards with images (product-card-personalized-coconut, product-card-coconut-stirrer, product-card-hip-flask, product-card-stamp) and correct Hinglish notes: 'Har Drink Mein Aapka Brand!', 'Your Brand. Your Style. Your Flask.', 'Aapka Logo • Aapki Branding • Aapka Style'. Each product card has an 'Enquire on WhatsApp' wa.me link. Logo drag/resize was not re-tested this run (already validated in iteration_6); logo-resize-slider is correctly hidden until an image is uploaded.
critical_code_review_comments: Customizer.jsx (~390 lines) is approaching the 700-line threshold; still fine, but consider extracting the draggable preview block and controls into a sub-component if it grows further.
Single global pointermove listener with a ref-based dispatcher ('text'|'logo') is clean; touchmove is registered with passive:false which is correct for preventDefault during drag.
seed_data_creation: One test order created via POST /api/orders (event_name='TEST Event', mobile='+919999999999', print_text='Radha\nand\nRupesh'). Order number MC-CE41A4.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For React controlled range inputs, set value via the native HTMLInputElement value setter and dispatch a bubbling 'input' event so React's onChange fires. Draggable preview blocks respond to pointer events on window; use page.mouse.down/move(step-by-step)/up to trigger updates. Products page slugs: personalized-coconut, coconut-stirrer, hip-flask, stamp.
